verdict.rationale: Clerky documents a first-party remote MCP server (mcp.clerky.com/mcp) that lets Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP-capable assistants use Clerky tools within authorized team access, and a live OAuth-gated endpoint confirms it exists. That gives users a real natural-language path into the product. However, the tools are described as read-only, so users can query Clerky but apparently cannot run its workflows (forming companies, issuing safes, filing forms) by command. missing for 10: write/action tools that let natural-language commands carry out Clerky workflows, a native in-product natural-language interface, documentation of the specific MCP tools offered, independent or hands-on corroboration of assistant-driven use.
